cohort: 139,873 women who gave birth at a major perinatal centre in Australia between January 2000 and April 2017
finding: Women who smoked during pregnancy had worse obstetric and perinatal outcomes compared to non-smokers.
mod_finding: Women who smoked were more likely to have a caesarean section for non-reassuring fetal status.
birth_weight: Infants of women who smoked had lower median birth weight
